item.title: Basic Workbench
item.description: The Basic Workbench is the first crafting station you build in Core Keeper. It unlocks the initial tool and equipment recipes. Use Crafts the Copper Pickaxe, Copper Sword and other early items Upgrade path: Iron Anvil → Gold Anvil → Scarlet Workbench

item.title: Furnace
item.description: The Furnace is the first ore-processing station in Core Keeper, smelting raw ore into bars for tools and equipment. It’s the bridge between mining copper/tin and crafting metal gear. What it processes Copper Ore → Copper Bar Tin Ore → Tin Bar Later: Iron, Gold and Scarlet bars for higher tiers The parallel furnace trick You can’t speed up a single furnace’s smelting time — but you can build several furnaces and process ores concurrently.
